flows:
Navigate to https://gs.statcounter.com/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Press the Tab key twice as the first two keyboard actions, before judging whether the target can be reached.
Continue with Tab or Shift+Tab as needed.
Reach Edit Chart Data below the main chart.
Press Enter and verify the chart settings form shows the Region selector.

summary:
The Edit Chart Data control was removed from the normal keyboard focus order even though it is a visible action button.
Restore Edit Chart Data to the normal keyboard focus order (for example, remove tabindex="-1") and verify that Tab can focus it and Enter opens the form with the Region selector.
